dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Emma, look at this news! A new planet has been discovered.
dialogue.reading: ˈɛmə, ˈlʊk ət ˈðɪs ˈnuːz! ə ˈnuː ˈplænɪt hæz bɪn dɪˈskʌvərd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Far away in outer space. Scientists found it with a big new telescope.
dialogue.reading: ˈfɑːr əˈweɪ ɪn ˈaʊtər ˈspeɪs. ˈsaɪəntɪsts ˈfaʊnd ɪt wɪð ə ˈbɪɡ ˈnuː ˈtɛləskoʊp.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Maybe. Water has been found on it, so scientists are very excited.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi. ˈwɔːtər hæz bɪn ˈfaʊnd ɑːn ɪt, soʊ ˈsaɪəntɪsts ər ˈvɛri ɪkˈsaɪtɪd.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Amazing! The universe is so big.
dialogue.reading: əˈmeɪzɪŋ! ðə ˈjuːnəvɜːrs ɪz ˈsoʊ ˈbɪɡ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I know. Thousands of planets have been found in the last thirty years.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈnoʊ. ˈθaʊzəndz əv ˈplænɪts hæv bɪn ˈfaʊnd ɪn ðə ˈlæst ˈθɜːrti ˈjɪrz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Would you like to be an astronaut?
dialogue.reading: wʊd juː ˈlaɪk tə bi ən ˈæstrənɔːt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No way! I'd be too scared. But several Thai satellites have been sent into space.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ ˈweɪ! aɪd bi ˈtuː ˈskɛrd. bʌt ˈsɛvrəl ˈtaɪ ˈsætəlaɪts hæv bɪn ˈsɛnt ˈɪntuː ˈspeɪs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Really? What are they used for?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? ˈwʌt ər ðeɪ ˈjuːzd ˈfɔːr?
